description: WA25: verify the proxied peer graph's SHAPE — bp <-> bp direct, bp <-> pn and pn <-> en through the tier, and an endpoint that never learns a producer. Peer counts are the signature; a 4-node mesh gives the endpoint 3 peers, so en1 == 1 distinguishes the two graphs. Complements go-stablenet/topology/01-proxied-pn-routing, which proves the tier RELAYS (a rising head on en) — true under a mesh too, so it does not pin the shape. LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-11 on the docker fleet, with a mesh control run.
